purpose: Separate KRK strategy-arbiter selector target labels before any sandbox or runtime selector.

target_kinds.meaning: The currently selected provider/move converted under the normal graph within the validation horizon.
target_kinds.allowed_use: measure current policy quality and guardrail regressions

target_kinds.meaning: A provider converted when forced for the first White move and then released to normal topology.
target_kinds.allowed_use: measure provider expressivity or candidate ownership opportunity

target_kinds.meaning: A provider produced or endorsed the same move as another provider but may not own the correct continuation.
A selection preserves protected lower-stage behavior and bridge tests.
The strategy selected a bounded handoff/plan window that exited or handed off successfully.
target_kinds.allowed_use: future Plan Capsule and strategy-monitor training labels

target_kinds.meaning: A state is reserved for architecture validation and must not be used as a direct optimization target.

dataset_rules: Every selector example must cite exactly one primary target_kind.
Forced-provider conversion labels must not be treated as direct runtime-selection labels.
Selected playout failures must not be treated as provider incapacity without forced-provider evidence.
Stage7 held-out challenge rows must remain excluded from training objectives until a review explicitly reclassifies them.
Guardrail safety must remain a separate gate, not a score target alone.

recommended_next_step.description: Replay-free dataset that maps existing labels into explicit target_kind buckets and excludes held-out Stage7 challenge rows from training targets.
